title: Mujahid UltraFPS
description: Mujahid UltraFPS is a lightweight Minecraft optimization modpack designed to improve FPS, reduce lag, speed up loading times, and provide a smoother gameplay experience while keeping the vanilla feel intact.
body:
Muji UltraFPS

Muji UltraFPS is a lightweight Fabric optimization modpack designed to maximize FPS, reduce lag, improve chunk loading, and provide a smoother Minecraft experience while keeping the game close to vanilla.

Features

🚀 Higher FPS through modern rendering optimizations

⚡ Faster chunk loading and world generation

🧠 Reduced RAM usage and improved memory management

🎮 Smoother gameplay and better frame consistency

🌍 Improved performance in both singleplayer and multiplayer

🎨 Shader support through Iris

🔧 Carefully selected optimization mods with minimal impact on vanilla gameplay

Included Optimization Mods

This modpack includes popular performance-enhancing mods such as:

Sodium
Lithium
ModernFix
FerriteCore
C2ME
ImmediatelyFast
Better Block Entities
Iris Shaders
Continuity
AppleSkin

and other supporting optimization mods.

Who Is This For?

Muji UltraFPS is ideal for:

Low-end PCs looking for better FPS
Mid-range systems seeking smoother gameplay
Players who want a vanilla-friendly optimization pack
Multiplayer players who want reduced lag and faster loading
Goal

The goal of Muji UltraFPS is simple:

Deliver the best possible Minecraft performance without changing the core vanilla experience.
